title: What Is a Tragic Hero?
skills: identify common characteristics of tragic heroes
analyze how flaws, choices, and circumstances contribute to a character's downfall
explain how tragic heroes support theme and dramatic meaning
alignment_note: Introduces the tragic hero as a central figure in tragedy and examines characteristics such as elevated status, personal flaws, consequential choices, and downfall. Supports characterization, tragedy analysis, thematic interpretation, and comparison of tragic protagonists across high school English courses.
